title: Pointwise convergence in nilmanifolds along smooth functions of polynomial growth
relevant_concepts: Host-Kra structure used after the orbit identification
notes: Ergod. Th. Dynam. Sys. 44 (2024), published 25 Sep 2023 (arXiv 2203.11609). Orbits b_i^{a_i(n)} Gamma with each a_i Hardy of polynomial growth. Same time-slot as Richter 2023: the entries must be Hardy in n. Does not cover a^{f(floor(h(n)))} with f a nonlinear Hardy monomial, and does not identify {floor(n^{3/2})^{9/4}}. The Host-Kra application is after a Hardy-time identification; it is not a license to run PET on the floor-Hardy Heisenberg lift (that method is already J-nil-pet-reentry). Cited by docs/problems/juggler_rate_free_floor_hardy.md.
